prix.q: Do I have to pay to start?
prix.a: No. You get a 14-day Standard trial, or 30 days with a valid referral code, without a bank card. You then choose a paid plan to continue taking bookings. Signing up does not authorise an automatic charge.

miseEnLigne.q: Is my page online straight away?
miseEnLigne.a: Your web address is reserved the moment you sign up, but the page goes public once our team has checked it. You can prepare your catalogue and opening hours in the meantime.

seule.q: What if I work on my own?
seule.a: That is the most common case. Simply create your own provider profile: your hours and your appointments attach to it.

paiement.q: How do my clients pay me?
paiement.a: Clients pay you using the methods you offer at your salon. The platform tracks deposits and their supporting documents. Your subscription payment is a separate process; KKIAPAY may be offered depending on your country and the active configuration.

donnees.q: Can I get my data back?
donnees.a: Yes, at any time. Your client list and your appointment history belong to you.

appel.sous: Start your trial, prepare your mini-site and calendar, then share your link after approval.

debut.q: When does my paid period start?
debut.r: Right after your current period (trial or paid month), without losing a day. Exception: Pro chosen during the trial opens on validation, and your remaining trial days are added to it. If your period has already ended, it starts when the payment is validated.

annuel.q: Can I switch from monthly to yearly?
annuel.r: Yes, at any time: choose the yearly plan and pay for it. Your year starts at the end of your current month.

versPro.q: If I switch from Standard to Pro, do I lose my paid days?
versPro.r: No. Pro opens as soon as your payment is validated, and your remaining Standard days are converted into Pro days pro rata to the monthly prices, then added to your Pro period. No refund, no extra charge.

versStandard.q: And if I go back from Pro to Standard?
versStandard.r: Your Pro plan runs to the end of what you've paid, then Standard takes over. Pro features pause — domain, appearance, assistants — but their settings are kept and come back if you return to Pro.

retard.q: What happens if I don't pay on time?
retard.r: You have 3 days of grace. After that, online bookings stop and the dashboard becomes read-only — your mini-site stays visible and your data stays intact. Everything reopens as soon as your payment is validated.

rappel.q: Will I get a reminder before the due date?
rappel.r: Yes, by email: a week before, three days before and the day before (a month before for the yearly plan), then at each step of your payment.
